 Speaker’s Card/Request to Speak: If you would like to address the City Council on a scheduled agenda
 item, please complete the Request to Speak Form. The card is at the table at the entrance to the Council
 Chamber. Please identify on the card your name, address, and the item on which you would like to speak
 and return to the City Clerk. The Request to Speak Form assists the Mayor in ensuring that all persons
 wishing to address the Council are recognized. Your name will be called at the time the matter is heard
 by the Council.

ROLL CALL

1.  CONSENT CALENDAR (Item Nos. 1.1 thru 1.12)

  All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and all will be enacted by
  one roll call vote. There will be no discussion of these items unless members of the City Council
  request specific items to be removed from the Consent Calendar for separate discussion. Any
  member of the public may address the Council on items on the Consent Calendar. Public
  comments on any item or items on the consent calendar are limited to three minutes per
  speaker. If you wish to speak to a particular item or items, please complete a Speakers Form
  and give it to the City Clerk. Please see information in Request to Speak section.

  1.1  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  ACTION:  Approve the minutes of a regular meeting of the City
  Council held on June 27, 2006.

  1.2  WARRANT AND WIRE TRANSFER RESOLUTION
 City Council Agenda  July 11, 2006

  ACTION:  Adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF IRVINE ALLOWING CERTAIN CLAIMS AND
  DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT OF WHICH THE
  SAME ARE TO BE PAID

  1.3  BARRANCA PARKWAY LANDSCAPE ENHANCEMENTS FROM
  JEFFREY ROAD TO SAND CANYON

  ACTION:  Approve the plans, specifications, and contract
  documents for Barranca Parkway Landscape Enhancements from
  Jeffrey Road to Sand Canyon, CIP 354210, on file with the Public
  Works Department.

  1.4  AGREEMENT FOR SECURITY SERVICES BETWEEN THE CITY OF
  IRVINE AND HERITAGE FIELDS EL TORO, LLC, A DELAWARE
  LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY

  ACTION:  Authorize the City Manager to approve and execute
  and the City Clerk to attest to an extension of Agreement No. 5115
  between the City of Irvine and Heritage Fields El Toro, LLC, a
  Delaware Limited Liability Company, the successor-in-interest to
  Heritage Fields, LLC, for security services at the former El Toro
  Marine Corps Air Station commencing July 1, 2006.

  1.5  UNIVERSITY COMMUNITY PARK LANDSCAPE REHABILITATION

  ACTION:  Approve the plans, specifications, and contract
  documents for University Park Landscaping, CIP 385000, on file
  with the Public Works Department.

  1.6  FAMILIES FORWARD REQUEST FOR FUNDING

  ACTION:  Approve Families Forward's request for $25,000 to
  match a Supportive Housing Program Grant and allocate funding
  from the anticipated Fiscal Year 2006 carryover.

  1.7  ORDINANCE NO. 06-06 AMENDING DIVISION 7 OF TITLE 1 OF THE
  IRVINE MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO THE REGULATION OF
  LOBBYING ACTIVITIES

  ACTION:  Adopt ORDINANCE NO. 06-06 – AN ORDINANCE
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE, CALIFORNIA,
  AMENDING DIVISION 7 OF TITLE 1 OF THE IRVINE MUNICIPAL
  CODE RELATING TO THE REGULATION OF LOBBYING
  ACTIVITIES

  ACTION:  Adopt ORDINANCE NO. 06-07 – AN ORDINANCE
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ADDING
  CHAPTER 5 OF DIVISION 9 OF TITLE 5 TO THE IRVINE
  MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING CONSTRUCTION SITE AND
  VACANT PROPERTY SECURITY

  1.9  ORDINANCE NO. 06-08, 17421 MURPHY AVENUE ZONE CHANGE
  (PLANNING AREA 36)

  ACTION:  Adopt ORDINANCE NO. 06-08 – AN ORDINANCE
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE APPROVING
  ZONE CHANGE 00390311-PZC TO REVISE TEXT IN THE
  ZONING CODE AND CHANGE THE ZONING ON LOT 17 OF
  TRACT 8018, AS SHOWN ON MAP FILED IN BOOK 435, PAGE
  7, FROM 5.1 IBC MULTI-USE TO 5.3D IBC RESIDENTIAL;
  LOCATED ON THE NORTHWEST CORNER OF KELVIN AND
  MURPHY; PLANNING AREA 36; FILED BY STARPOINTE
  VENTURES ON BEHALF OF JAMBOREE HOUSING
  CORPORATION

  1.10  DESIGNATION OF VOTING DELEGATES FOR LEAGUE OF
  CALIFORNIA CITIES ANNUAL CONFERENCE

  ACTION:  Appoint Mayor Beth Krom as the voting delegate and
  Councilmember Choi as the voting delegate alternate for the
  League of California Cities Conference Annual Business Meeting.

  1.11  REVISION OF THE NAVY'S CONVEYANCE TO SECOND HARVEST
  FOOD BANK

  ACTION:  Approve the revision to the Second Harvest
  conveyance and authorize the City Manager to sign a letter to the
  Department of the Navy accepting the modification to the current
  conveyance.

  1.12  CONDITIONAL USE PERMITS FOR TEN WIRELESS
  COMMUNICATIONS FACILITIES LOCATED IN THE PUBLIC RIGHTS-
  OF-WAY AND/OR PUBLIC UTILITY EASEMENTS IN TURTLE ROCK
  (PLANNING AREA 21)

  ACTION:  Indefinitely postpone the public hearing on the
  condition that Sprint execute an agreement that is satisfactory to

END OF CONSENT CALENDAR

2.  COUNCIL BUSINESS

  2.1  APPOINTMENT OF A CITY COUNCIL REPRESENTATIVE TO THE
  SOUTH COUNTY MAJOR INVESTMENT STUDY WORKING GROUP

  ACTION:  Appoint a City Council representative to the Policy
  Working Group for the South Orange County Major Investment
  Study.

  2.2  DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION REGARDING CHILD CARE
  IN IRVINE

  2.3  REPORT OF THE ORANGE COUNTY GRAND JURY

  ACTION:  Review the findings and recommendations of the
  June 14, 2006 report of the Orange County Grand Jury and provide
  staff direction for preparation of a response.

INTRODUCTIONS

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

ANNOUNCEMENTS/COMMITTEE REPORTS/COUNCIL REPORTS

  Announcements, Committee Reports and Council Comments are for the purpose of presenting
  brief comments or reports, are subject to California Government Code Section 54954.2 of the
  Brown Act and are limited to 15-minutes per meeting.

ADDITIONS AND DELETIONS

  Additions to the agenda are limited by California Government Code Section 54954.2 of the
  Brown Act and for those items that arise after the posting of the Agenda and must be acted upon
  prior to the next City Council meeting.

4.  COUNCIL BUSINESS (Continued)

  4.1  IRVINE BUSINESS COMPLEX (IBC) RESIDENTIAL MIXED-USE
  VISION PLAN AND OVERLAY ZONE STRATEGY

  ACTION:
  1)  Receive staff report.
  2)  Receive public input.
  3)  City Council comments and questions.
  4)  Direct staff to:

  • Prepare an Environmental Impact report on the Draft Overlay
  Zoning Code and Draft IBC Vision Plan, which embody and
  represent the Council’s expectations for current and future
  residential development in the IBC. The Environmental Impact
  Report shall also analyze a Town Center concept and anticipated
  infrastructure improvements.

  • Prepare a scope of work on the Environmental Impact Report for

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  5
 City Council Agenda  July 11, 2006

  the Draft Overlay Zoning Code, Draft IBC Vision Plan, Town Center
  concept, and anticipated infrastructure improvements, for
  presentation to the City Council within six months.

  • Direct staff to explore development agreement opportunities for
  all residential General Plan Amendments and zone changes to
  allow for funding of potential improvements in the IBC area.

  5)  Introduce for first reading an ORDINANCE OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE, CALIFORNIA, ADDING
  CHAPTER 8 TO DIVISION 7 OF TITLE 2 OF THE IRVINE
  MUNICIPAL CODE DESIGNATING CERTAIN POWERS TO
  COMMUNITY FACILITIES DISTRICTS FORMED PURSUANT TO
  THE MELLO-ROOS ACT

  4.2  DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING NINE IRVINE BUSINESS
  COMPLEX RESIDENTIAL PROJECTS

  ACTION:
  1)  Receive staff report.
  2)  Council comments and questions.

5.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  Public Hearings are scheduled for a time certain of 4:00 p.m., unless noticed otherwise, or as
  soon thereafter as possible. Those wishing to address the City Council during the Public
  Hearing must complete a Request to Speak form and provide it to the City Clerk prior to the
  hearing. If, in the future, you wish to challenge in court any of the matters on this agenda for
  which a public hearing is to be conducted, you may be limited to raising only those issues which
  you, or someone else raised orally at the public hearing or in written correspondence received by
  the City at or before the hearing. Any person seeking to challenge a City Council decision made
  as a result of a proceeding in which by law a hearing is required to be given, evidence is required
  to be taken, and the discretion in the determination of facts is vested in the City Council, shall be
  required to commence that action 90 days following the date on which the decision becomes
  final as provided in Code of Civil Procedure Section 1094.6. Please refer to Code of Civil
  Procedure 1094.6 to determine how to calculate when a decision becomes final.
  Notice: Public Hearings listed for continuance will be continued as noted and posting of this
  agenda serves as notice of continuation. Any matter not noted for continuance, will be posted
  separately.

  5.1  AMENDMENT TO THE METROPOLITAN CONDOMINIUMS

  Council comments and questions.
  2)  Close public hearing.

 City Council Agenda  July 11, 2006

  3)  Adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  IRVINE RESCINDING CITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. 93-55,
  TERMINATING AND RELEASING THE AFFORDABILITY
  COVENANTS ON FOUR CONDOMINIUM UNITS AT THE
  METROPOLITAN CONDOMINIUM OWNED BY JAMBOREE

  5.2  AFFORDABLE HOUSING IN-LIEU FEE INCREASE/ANNUAL
  ADJUSTMENT

  ACTION:
  1)  Open the public hearing, receive staff report, receive public input,
  Council comments and questions.
  2)  Close public hearing.
  3)  Adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  IRVINE APPROVING AN INCREASE TO THE AFFORDABLE

END OF COUNCIL BUSINESS

PUBLIC COMMENTS (Limited to 3 minutes per speaker) - 6:00 P.M.

ADJOURNMENT

Next Meeting: CITY COUNCIL REGULAR meeting, July 25, 2006, 10:00 p.m., City of
Irvine, City Council Chamber, One Civic Center Plaza, Irvine, California.
  NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
  ADJOURNMENT
At 11:00 p.m., the City Council will determine which of the remaining agenda items can be considered
and acted upon prior to 12:00 midnight and will continue all other items on which additional time is
required until a future City Council meeting. All meetings are scheduled to terminate at 12:00 midnight.

  STAFF REPORTS

As a general rule, staff reports or other written documentation have been prepared or organized with
respect to each item of business listed on the agenda. Copies of these materials are on file with the City
Clerk and are available for public inspection and copying. If you have any questions regarding any item of
business on the agenda for this meeting, or any of the staff reports or other documentation relating to any
agenda item, please contact City Clerk staff at (949)724-6205.

  CITY SERVICES TO FACILITATE ACCESS TO PUBLIC MEETINGS

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  7
 City Council Agenda  July 11, 2006

It is the intention of the City of Irvine to comply with the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) in all
respects. If, as an attendee or a participant at this meeting, you will need special assistance beyond what
is normally provided, the City of Irvine will attempt to accommodate you in every reasonable manner.
Please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (949)724-6205.

Assisted listening devices are available at the meeting for individuals with hearing impairments.
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure
accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35. 102-35. 104 ADA Title II)

  CHALLENGING CITY DECISIONS

The time limit within which to commence any lawsuit or legal challenge to any quasi-adjudicative decision
made by the City is governed by Section 1094.6 of the Code of Civil Procedure, unless a shorter
limitations period is specified by any other provision. Under Section 1094.6, any lawsuit or legal challenge
  th
to any quasi-adjudicative decision made by the City must be filed no later than the 90 day following the
date on which such decision becomes final. Any lawsuit or legal challenge, which is not filed within that
90-day period, will be barred.

If a person wishes to challenge the nature of the above actions in court, they may be limited to raising
only those issues they or someone else raised at the meeting described in this notice, or in written
correspondence delivered to the City of Irvine, at or prior to the meeting. In addition, judicial challenge
may be limited or barred where the interested party has not sought and exhausted all available
administrative remedies.

  COMMUNICATION DEVICES

To minimize distractions, please be sure all personal communication devices are turned off or on silent
mode.
  MEETING SCHEDULE

Regular meetings of the City Council are held on the second and fourth Tuesdays of each month at 4:00
p.m. Study Sessions and/or Closed Sessions are periodically held prior to the start of the regular meeting.
